people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
translations.bsb: The nations will hear and tremble; anguish will grip the dwellers of Philistia.
translations.kjv: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
translations.asv: The peoples have heard, they tremble: Pangs have taken hold on the inhabitants of Philistia.
